lines: Yomihara, the city in the bowels of the earth where crime and desire intertwined.
This city, which dwelled in the depths far below Tokyo, was continuing to expand even now as they excavated the earth, and it was said that only a limited few knew the full scope of it.
In one corner of that Yomihara, on a back street, there was a restaurant.
「Scuse me, I have an order too!」
Even for the back streets of Yomihara, which were crowded night and day, this establishment was especially teeming with life.
The people waiting for seats were even overflowing outside the restaurant. And leaking out from within were heat, the mixed laughter of men and women of all ages, and a savoury aroma.
Minasaki ran around the floor hectically, then flung the orders she had gathered into the kitchen.
The one who enthusiastically received them was Lilim. While briskly chopping meat at the counter, she called out to a woman sitting at the back.
The woman who had been referred to as Astaroth held a hand out, and red, boiling-hot flame――no, magma appeared.
When she put that in the oven, the meat sizzled and gave off steam.
「Whew, nice smell! Wow, thanks to Astaroth-san, we're making a fortune!」
「A hellish yougan steakhouse, where I can hide away from the succubi, and make heaps of money too. Ahh, Lilim-chan really is a genius!」
While talking to herself like that, Lilim moved the skillfully-cooked meat onto a plate.
「Minasakiii! Two servings of Hellish Yougan-Yaki, ready and waiting!」
Those steaks, which had been grilled by the heat of the Demon World magma that Astaroth had summoned, were gaining popularity as 『Hellish Yougan-Yaki』.
Their exquisite amount of grilling, which sealed in the umami, and the faint scent of magical energy that wafted off of them, captivated the tongues of demons especially.
Eventually, rumours of it spread to humans as well, and it had now reached the point where the lines that formed transcended age, gender and species.
Even Astaroth, who controlled the fire behind the counter, was said to play a part in its popularity, being referred to as 『the beautiful meat grilling girl』, and things to that effect.
「But, being able to summon Demon World magma... Who even are you, Astaroth-san?」
『Astaroth of the Inferno』――That name sent shivers through the inhabitants of Hell.
In one corner of the Demon World, there was a land where scorching-hot magma flowed. In the heart of it was Astaroth's manor.
Inside that manor. In a spacious room adorned with stately decor, a man with a brawny physique was engulfed in flames.
「You intended to challenge me with that little strength? I struggle to comprehend what weak people think.」
「Well, it's a considerable feat just to make it this far, so I shall commend you♪ But ultimately, no more than that.」
Those words no longer reached the man. His body had been melted by the intense heat, and disappeared without even leaving ashes behind.
『Astaroth of the Inferno』 was known throughout the Demon World for her unrivalled strength, beauty, and combative personality, but
Perhaps having caught wind of those rumours, foolhardy men would visit her like this from time to time.
Harbouring lust and aspirations of trying to break the arrogant queen's fighting spirit, make her their woman, and take her land and status for themselves.
However, most of them burned to nothing on the scorching-hot ground, unable to even reach the manor.
「Awww, how boring. I'm going to go frigid from all these weak men.」
「I wonder if there aren't any men strong enough to get me hotter. Do you suppose, Vesta?」
Astaroth called out to the white-haired woman who was standing behind her in a corner of the room.
「There are only a handful of people in Hell powerful enough to oppose Astaroth-sama.」
「Which means there are some, doesn't it?♪」
「I suppose so. The famous Edwin Black, for instance......」
Having heard that name, Astaroth looked away disappointedly.
「I'll pass on him. We've never seen eye to eye. I don't wish to have too much to do with him.」
「They say he's been expanding into the human world of late. I wonder what's so fun about that?」
It had now been many hundreds of years since Astaroth had come to rule over this land.
She and Edwin Black, who was also a strong and immortal individual, knew, but did not interfere with, one another.
「It's difficult for the likes of me to understand what Edwin Black is plotting, but......」
「I hear that the human world has now gotten lively, and strong people are flocking there one after another.」
Astaroth appeared to have considered something briefly, but
「How many years has it been since you came here?」
「Huh......? About a hundred and thirty years, I think.」
「I see. Thinking about it, your flames have gotten stronger as well, haven't they?」
Vesta bowed her head in gratitude.
She had been born to a tribe of dark elves, but due to her unique appearance, she had grown up being persecuted as a child who would invite disaster.
However, after that, through many twists and turns, she had been found by Astaroth, and her talent as a flame wielder had blossomed.
By now, she had become such a powerful person that a part of this scorching-hot territory had been left in her hands.
「If you have that much power, you'll be capable of at least guarding the place while I'm out, then♪」
「I'm going out. For a little stroll.」
「The human world. I have nothing to do, so I'm going to see whether there really are strong people there or not.」
「I'd quite like to pick up a lovely pet while I'm at it, too♪」
With the same kind of casualness as if she were going to the convenience store or something, Astaroth enveloped herself in flames, then immediately disappeared in the blink of an eye.
――And so, she had casually passed through the Hell Gate and come to Yomihara.
「And it's true that if I stay here, I'll be able to encounter strong men, yes?」
Being eyed by Astaroth, Lilim jumped with a start.
「I-It's true! After all, Yomihara here is a town that's swarming with the strong, human and demon!」
「Once talk of this yougan-yaki spreads, famous tough guys'll be coming to eat here in droves...... probably...」
「Hmmm...... Well, it's not like I'm in a hurry, so I don't mind that much, though♪」
Having escaped the succubi, Lilim had met up with Minasaki again, and, rather than learning her lesson, had been thinking up ways to earn money.
At that point, she had met Astaroth and brought her here, putting the idea in her head that 『You'll be able to meet strong guys』.
Astaroth didn't have high expectations of those two, but that said, if they were lying, she planned on incinerating them without delay.
（She's scary. After she makes us a little more money, I wonder if we should try and leg it?～）
All of a sudden, a loud noise broke out in front of the store, and the clamorous interior fell silent in an instant.
And then, the door was kicked open violently, and no sooner had that happened than gun-wielding men came rushing in.
The men looked around the inside of the restaurant, and caught sight of Astaroth, who was fuelling the fire behind the counter, unperturbed.
「You've some nerve, telling me to extinguish my fire. In deference to that nerve, I'll burn you to a crisp in one second.」
While intimidating all around them, the men charged behind the counter.
